newsitem.title: USA: Margate sees possible strike impact.
newsitem.headline: Margate sees possible strike impact.

text.p: Margate Industries Inc said Tuesday that a prolonged strike at certain Detroit-area automotive plants could have a negative impact on the sales and performance of Margate and its 45 percent owned New Haven Foundry unit.
Strikes continue at some Chrysler Corp and General Motors Corp facilities.

Margate said it continued to add new customers and work at its Wisconsin and Michigan castings units, including several independent foundries and major car and truck manufacturers. It said new customers are helping it offset the impact of the strikes at the auto plants.
Earlier, Margate reported first quarter earnings of $0.04 a share, up from $0.01 a year ago.
"We are very pleased with our results, which represent a solid return to profitability following losses in the last two quarters of 1996," William Hopton, Margate president, said in a statement.
